basic_info.description: Charming 1930s home on a prime Outer Sunset block. Expansive ocean views are showcased from the rear bedrooms on BOTH levels and the deck. An ornate fireplace gives the living room a nice refined feel. Beautiful hardwood floors cover most of the main level. The kitchen is bright and cheery. An interior staircase leads to two more bedrooms and a handy second bath. Inviting and serene best describes the backyard. Space for parking and laundry is found in the garage. If you are looking for a move-in ready home with great views in a quintessential Outer Sunset location, look no further than 1587 40th Avenue. Here's you chance to be just a few blocks from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and all the cool shops along Judah.
